items.title: Ellis Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: people talked about Methuselah, in the Bible, lived 900 years.

ctx.x: cultivated. But that’s on them. As you say, that student came up to you later and said, “You saved my life.” You had no idea.

No. See, just in terms of systemically trying to create information in such a way that the student can ingest that and utilize it – the academy is good in a sense of organ[izing]. I remember when I discovered there’s only two things that you can get out of an academy. One is a system of organization. Two is a source of reference. That’s it. There ain’t nothing else to get. If the students can be helped to understand that – the growth cycle is definitely connected to the individual. I think it’s a common – I think…
Duke, Charlie Parker. Yeah, of course.
